**Finding: deviation (RENEWAL)** — Article IV Term, paragraph p0049.

The renewal mechanic lets the Licensor unilaterally extend the 36-month Initial Period by seven years, with no Licensee opt-out and no renewal price cap. That is an automatic/imposed multi-year renewal at the Vendor's election, which fails the fallback (auto-renewal with ≤60-day notice window, uplift ≤5%) and falls into walk-away territory. The mutual-extension sentences at Article IV(II)–(III) conflict with, but do not cure, the Licensor option.

Redline (validated, preferred position): successive 12-month renewal periods, either party may decline on 30 days' written notice, and renewal fee increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
